name: Religion
summary: Knowledge of deities, rites, and holy symbols.
description: Your Intelligence (Religion) check measures your ability to recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, religious hierarchies, holy symbols, and the practices of secret cults.
typicalUses: Identify cults, holy symbols, rites, divine lore.
exampleChecks: Recognize a desecrated altar; recall a god's dogma; identify undead origins.
